tagline: Keeps your library lean and playable — finds duplicate copies, broken files, oversized encodes and unwanted language tracks, then fixes them safely.
scanNever: No scan has run yet. Click "Scan now" to check your libraries.
fixDone: Fix run finished — see History for what was done.
fixNothingToDo: Nothing to fix yet — approve issues on the Issues tab, or switch a fix type to "Fix automatically" in Settings, then click again.
dryRunOn: Approved fixes are only rehearsed and logged to History. When the plan looks right, turn off dry-run to let MediaDash make real changes.
diskContext: {0} free of {1} on your library drives
statGpuMissing: No GPU counter available on this host
noIssues: No issues found — your library is in good shape. New scans run automatically on schedule.
noHistory: Nothing has been fixed yet. Fixes appear here after a fix run, with a Restore button for anything recoverable.
showingOf: Showing the first {0} of {1} issues. Use the filter above to narrow the list.
approveHint: Queues this fix for the next fix run.
dismissHint: Excludes this file from future scans of this issue type — it won’t be reported again.
approveAllNote: Approves every issue currently listed — each will be fixed on the next fix run.
approved: Approved — will be handled by the next fix run.
dismissed: Ignored — this file won’t be reported again.
restoreHint: Puts the file back exactly where it was.
confirmAuto: Automatic mode will change files whenever the server is idle, without asking. Removed files go to the recycle bin (unless set to permanent delete). Continue?
confirmPermanent: Permanent delete means removed files CANNOT be recovered. Are you sure?
confirmEmptyBin: Permanently delete everything in the recycle bin? Restore will no longer be possible for those files.
confirmReset: Clear all detected issues and probe/decode caches? Fix history and the recycle bin are kept. No media files will be touched.
resetDone: Scan data cleared — click "Scan now" to start fresh.
resetBusy: Cannot reset right now: a scan or fix is running. Wait for it to finish, then try again.
binRestoreHint: To put a file back, use the Restore button on the History tab.

Duplicate.title: Duplicate copies
Duplicate.hint: The same movie or episode exists more than once.
Duplicate.actionHint: Queues deletion of this copy for the next fix run; the better copy stays.
Duplicate.doRecycle: Delete the worse copy — recoverable from the recycle bin

Playability.title: Files that won't play
Playability.hint: These files are broken or unreadable.
Playability.actionHint: Queues removal for the next fix run (re-checked as broken before anything is removed).
Playability.doRecycle: Remove the broken file — recoverable from the recycle bin

Quality.title: Files wasting space
Quality.hint: Bigger than your chosen quality ceiling.
Quality.actionHint: Queues a re-encode down to your quality ceiling for the next fix run; the original goes to the recycle bin.
Quality.doRecycle: Re-encode to the quality ceiling — original kept in recycle bin
Quality.doPermanent: Re-encode to the quality ceiling — original deleted permanently

SubtitleLanguage.title: Subtitles
SubtitleLanguage.hint: Strip unwanted-language subtitle tracks and (optionally) trim embedded fonts from .ass sidecars.
SubtitleLanguage.actionHint: Queues removal of unwanted subtitle tracks (and font-optimize passes when enabled) for the next fix run.
SubtitleLanguage.doRecycle: Remove unwanted subtitle tracks — original kept in recycle bin
SubtitleLanguage.doPermanent: Remove unwanted subtitle tracks — original deleted permanently

SubtitleFonts.title: Subtitles
SubtitleFonts.hint: Embedded fonts in .ass sidecar subtitles that no style actually uses.
SubtitleFonts.actionHint: Rewrites the .ass file with only the fonts your styles reference. Contents-only edit — the file stays a valid subtitle.

CorruptNfo.title: Corrupt NFO files
CorruptNfo.hint: Zero-byte, malformed, or unrecognised-root .nfo sidecars that stop Jellyfin from reading metadata.
CorruptNfo.actionHint: Removes the broken .nfo file. Jellyfin's next library scan tries to build metadata from providers or embedded tags.
CorruptNfo.doRecycle: Delete the NFO — recoverable from the recycle bin

AudioLanguage.title: Unwanted audio
AudioLanguage.hint: Audio tracks in languages you don't keep.
AudioLanguage.actionHint: Queues removal of the unwanted audio tracks for the next fix run.
AudioLanguage.doRecycle: Remove unwanted audio — original kept in recycle bin
AudioLanguage.doPermanent: Remove unwanted audio — original deleted permanently

Misplaced.title: Misplaced files
Misplaced.hint: A movie in the TV folder, or a TV episode in the Movies folder.
Misplaced.actionHint: Moves the file into the target folder configured in Settings → Libraries.

Ungrouped.title: Ungrouped media
Ungrouped.hint: Loose files or oddly-named folders that should sit under a per-title (or per-franchise) parent folder.
Ungrouped.actionHint: Moves the file or folder into a folder named after Jellyfin's identified title (franchise stem when siblings share it).

MissingSubtitles.title: Missing subtitles
MissingSubtitles.hint: No subtitle in any of your kept languages.
MissingSubtitles.actionHint: Downloads one via Jellyfin's configured subtitle providers (OpenSubtitles etc.).

Stale.title: Stale content
Stale.hint: Nobody has played it in a long time.
Stale.actionHint: Detect-only for now — MediaDash surfaces the list, you decide whether to delete or keep.

MalwareRisk.title: Suspicious executables
MalwareRisk.hint: Programs or scripts sitting in a media folder — almost always malware from a pirated release.
MalwareRisk.actionHint: Queues deletion for the next fix run; the file goes to the recycle bin unless you switch it to permanent.
MalwareRisk.doRecycle: Delete the executable — recoverable from the recycle bin

HeavyTranscode.title: Heavy transcodes
HeavyTranscode.hint: Files that keep transcoding on the fly instead of direct-playing.
HeavyTranscode.actionHint: Queues a one-off re-encode with the plugin's own settings so future plays become direct-play.
HeavyTranscode.doRecycle: Re-encode; keep the original in the recycle bin

FailedTranscode.title: Failed transcodes
FailedTranscode.hint: Recent transcode attempts failed (non-zero ffmpeg exit or a 'Conversion failed' tail).
FailedTranscode.actionHint: Runs a targeted re-encode with MediaDash's settings; often succeeds where the on-the-fly attempt didn't.
FailedTranscode.doRecycle: Retry; keep the original in the recycle bin

OrphanedDebris.title: Orphaned debris
OrphanedDebris.hint: Empty folders, orphan subtitles, orphan trickplay folders and orphan metadata whose parent no longer exists.
OrphanedDebris.actionHint: Re-verifies at fix time that the parent still doesn't exist; refuses if a companion has reappeared.

LargeTrickplay.title: Trickplay space savings
LargeTrickplay.hint: Scrub-bar preview thumbnails are still raw JPG — re-encoding to WebP typically halves the disk footprint.
LargeTrickplay.actionHint: Runs the bundled jellyfin-ffmpeg with libwebp. The .jpg extension is kept so Jellyfin clients continue serving them exactly the same way.

EmbeddedCoverArt.title: Embedded cover art
EmbeddedCoverArt.hint: Music or audiobook folders with per-file embedded covers but no folder-level cover.jpg.
EmbeddedCoverArt.actionHint: Writes cover.jpg once and (optionally) strips the redundant per-file copies.
EmbeddedCoverArt.approveAll: Extract shared covers for all {0} folders shown

CorruptArtwork.title: Corrupt artwork
CorruptArtwork.hint: Poster / backdrop / thumb files inside Jellyfin's metadata folder that are zero-byte, truncated, or fail to decode.
CorruptArtwork.actionHint: Removes the broken image; Jellyfin's next library scan re-fetches from providers.
CorruptArtwork.approveAll: Delete all {0} corrupt artwork files shown

html.settings.safety.title: Safety
html.settings.safety.subtitle: Guardrails that keep every scan and fix reversible.
html.settings.safety.dryRunHint: On (default): fix runs only log what they would do — nothing is changed. Turn off once you're happy with the plan shown in History.
html.settings.safety.idle: Only run when the server is idle
html.settings.safety.idleHint: On (default): scheduled scans and fixes wait until nobody is watching anything and nobody has used Jellyfin for 15 minutes. The "Scan now" and "Run fixes now" buttons always run immediately. This overrides the scheduled time below — if the server is busy when the schedule fires, the run is skipped.
html.settings.safety.analytics: Share anonymous stats with the community board
html.settings.safety.analyticsHint: Sends per-month, per-scanner fix counts + total bytes freed + plugin/Jellyfin version, tagged with a month-rotated anonymous ID (SHA-256 of Jellyfin's SystemId + this year-month; changes on the 1st of every month, no persistent UUID stored on disk). On by default; untick here to opt out. No paths, no filenames, no usernames. See docs/PRIVACY.md.
html.task.scan.name: Scan libraries for issues
html.task.scan.description: Looks for duplicates, unplayable files, oversized encodes, unwanted language tracks, misplaced files and videos missing subtitles.
html.task.fix.name: Apply approved fixes
html.task.fix.description: Applies approved and automatic fixes: removes duplicates, re-encodes oversized files, strips unwanted tracks.
